from scipy import stats
fac = load("fac")
grp = [fac[(fac.elem == e) & (fac.frame == f)].mil_t2.values
       for e in (0, 1) for f in (0, 1)]
print([len(x) for x in grp], [float(round(x.mean(), 2)) for x in grp])
F, p = stats.f_oneway(*grp)
print(round(F, 3), round(p, 4))
# [110, 106, 109, 105] [4.9, 4.81, 4.95, 5.2]
# 1.728 0.1605

pairs = [(i, j) for i in range(4) for j in range(i + 1, 4)]
ps = [stats.ttest_ind(grp[i], grp[j]).pvalue for i, j in pairs]
print(len(ps), sum(q < .05 for q in ps), round(min(ps), 4))
print(round(.05 / len(ps), 4), sum(q < .05 / len(ps) for q in ps))
# 6 1 0.0308
# 0.0083 0

w = np.array([-1, 1/3, 1/3, 1/3])   # 통제 −1, 처치 받은 세 칸 ⅓씩 (합 = 0)
m = np.array([x.mean() for x in grp])
n = np.array([len(x) for x in grp])
dfw = n.sum() - 4
mse = sum(((x - x.mean()) ** 2).sum() for x in grp) / dfw
est = w @ m
se = np.sqrt(mse * (w ** 2 / n).sum())
t = est / se
p = 2 * stats.t.sf(abs(t), dfw)
half = stats.t.ppf(.975, dfw) * se
print(round(est, 3), round(se, 3), round(t, 2), round(p, 3))
print(round(est - half, 2), round(est + half, 2))

# -0.2 0.36
